INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making.

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Information: Interrogatives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
